title: UseFullknowledge document frontmatter
description: Flat frontmatter for every knowledge artifact. Keys are deliberately flat, never nested: nested YAML makes `rg '^review_status: verified'` return zero results with no error, which is a silent false negative on the most important query in the corpus. `format:` keywords are deliberately unused - jsonschema does not enforce them without rfc3339-validator, so every constraint here is a `pattern`.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 with an explicit timezone offset, exact to the second.

id.description: Immutable identity, `<slug>-<4 hex>`. Decoupled from path so a rename never breaks a reference.

summary.description: One paragraph. This is what an agent reads in the catalog before deciding to fetch the document.

tags.description: Open vocabulary. CI reports drift but never fails on an unknown tag - the alternative is agents dumping everything into whatever tag already exists.

created_by_tool.description: The AI tool or human that produced this, e.g. claude-code, cursor, chatgpt, human.

created_by_model.description: Model identifier, e.g. claude-opus-5. Use 'none' for human-authored content.

created_by_session.description: Reference to the originating prompt or session, where one exists.

updated_by.description: Which human or agent performed the last update.

review_status.description: Defaults to unreviewed. Only a human can set verified - enforced below.

confidence_basis.description: Structured evidence, not a self-assessed score. A bare confidence number from a model is worthless; the basis is checkable.

sources.description: Required whenever confidence_basis claims a citation.

volatility.description: Drives the computed shelf life. Thermodynamics is evergreen; a JS framework's API is fast.

aliases.description: Previous ids, so links survive a rename.

lang.description: Language of a snippet, e.g. python, bash, typescript.

lang_version.description: The version this snippet was actually valid for, e.g. 3.12.

prompt_target.description: Which tool or model a prompt/skill artifact targets.

allOf.$comment: Anything past unreviewed must name who reviewed it and when.
The premise of the system: an agent can never self-promote to verified.
Claiming a citation obliges you to produce one.
C4 levels only mean something for C4 diagrams.
